title: How the SpaceX IPO could rewrite space investing
title_zh: SpaceX 首次公开募股将如何改写太空投资
summary: Market Domination Host Josh Lipton welcomes Fortuna Investments CEO Justus Parmar to discuss investing in the future of private space company SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) and Elon Musk himself.
summary_zh: 《市场支配》主持人 Josh Lipton 欢迎 Fortuna Investments 首席执行官 Justus Parmar 讨论投资私人太空公司 SpaceX (SPAX.PVT) 和埃隆·马斯克本人的未来。

title: Dow jumps 800 points, S&P 500 at new record, Nasdaq gains 6.8% this week
title_zh: 道琼斯指数跃升 800 点，标普 500 指数再创新高，纳指本周上涨 6.8%
summary: All three of the market indexes (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) closed Friday's session with significant gains, led by the Dow Jones Industrial Average which rose by nearly 868 points (1.79%) in the day.
summary_zh: 所有三个市场指数（^DJI、^IXIC、^GSPC）周五收盘均大幅上涨，道琼斯工业平均指数领涨，当天上涨近 868 点（1.79%）。

title: Tesla to break eight-week losing streak. What's driving the stock?
title_zh: 特斯拉打破八周连跌。是什么推动了该股？
summary: Tesla (TSLA) is on track to end the trading week nearly 15% higher as the EV maker hopes to snap its eight-week-long losing streak.
summary_zh: 电动汽车制造商特斯拉 (TSLA) 有望结束其长达八周的连续下跌，该公司本周交易有望上涨近 15%。

title: Exclusive-Meta targets May 20 for first wave of layoffs; additional cuts later in 2026
title_zh: Exclusive-Meta 预计 5 月 20 日进行第一波裁员； 2026 年晚些时候进一步削减
summary: Meta intends to conduct a first wave of sweeping layoffs planned for this year on May 20, with more coming later, three sources ‌familiar with the plans told Reuters.
summary_zh: 三位熟悉该计划的消息人士告诉路透社，Meta 计划于 5 月 20 日进行今年第一波大规模裁员，随后还会有更多裁员。

title: Market rally breakdown: Dow Jones, bitcoin, Tesla, and more
title_zh: 市场反弹细分：道琼斯、比特币、特斯拉等
summary: On Friday, the Dow Jones Industrial Average (^DJI) surged over 800 points, while both the S&P 500 (^GSPC) and Nasdaq Composite (^IXIC) gained over 1% each.
summary_zh: 周五，道琼斯工业平均指数 (^DJI) 飙升超过 800 点，而标准普尔 500 指数 (^GSPC) 和纳斯达克综合指数 (^IXIC) 均上涨超过 1%。

title: Markets eye 3rd week of gains as Robinhood stock leads S&P 500
title_zh: Robinhood 股票领先标准普尔 500 指数，市场预计将连续第三周上涨
summary: As US stocks (^DJI, ^GSPC, ^IXIC) are set to close out with a third straight week of gains, Yahoo Finance Senior Producer John Hyland takes a closer look at this week's market action.
summary_zh: 由于美国股市（^DJI、^GSPC、^IXIC）将连续第三周上涨，雅虎财经高级制作人 John Hyland 仔细审视了本周的市场走势。
